title: My Hobby: Where? There? Right Here~!!

text_block_list.text: This happened during our free time at summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, there's somewhere I wanna go!
Come with me! You will, right? Come on, come on!
choice_data_list: Sure, but... where to?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A · FUN · PLACE♡

text_block_list.name: Sewing Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Has everyone received their plushie fabric?
Now, let's decide which animal to make next! After that, we'll cut the patterns―
choice_data_list: (Wait, a sewing class...?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“Like at that plushie sewing class...
On my very first day, mine was used as the sample model―”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm making a doggy! It looks just like you♡
...Hm, what's wrong? Ah, are you mad? Wait, are you a cat person?!
choice_data_list: ...Didn't you say you got bored of sewing?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ well... don't worry 'bout that!
Come on, you gotta decide what you're making too♪

...She seems to have something in mind.
For now, let's just make a plushie.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aww yeah, finished one ear at last~!!
...Hnnng... doing the other one sounds like such a drag. Break time~.
choice_data_list: I'm gonna finish mine while you slack off, though.
I'm gonna finish mine while you take a break, though.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Grrr, look at that smug face on you~!!
Fine then, I'm gonna power through too!!
And so―both plushies were safely completed.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eee~♡ The one you made is so, soooo cute!
Wait, doesn't it kind of look like me??
choice_data_list: Consider it payback for making a doggy of me.
Consider it payback for making a doggy of me.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
! Nihihi. ...Hey, I'll give you mine,
so you gimme yours! Pretty please, come on♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!! Look, look!!
That hand mirror prize is soooo pink and cute, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Owner
text_block_list.text:
If you take turns, pairs are welcome to play~!
Though... that prize over there is the toughest to knock down. Think you can manage it~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really~?
...Well, since you put it like that, right~?
choice_data_list: If he's gonna challenge us like that, how can we say no?

text_block_list.text: (POP!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Owner
text_block_list.text: What?! ...Sh-She rotated the whole target in a single shot!
choice_data_list: I see, so if I aim high...

text_block_list.text: (PEW-POP!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Owner
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~... Too bad! Just grazed the top.
Alright! Only one shot left to go~!!
choice_data_list: Sorry!... I leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me♡ That fine adjustment was super clutch, y'know?
...Down the hatch♡
(POP!)

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Owner
text_block_list.text: No way―she made it look so effortless...! Are you... for real―

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Staff
text_block_list.text:
CONGRATULATIOOOOONS!!
Here is your priiiiize!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Waaah♡ Isn't this super stylish?!
Well?! Does it suit me?? Super duper cute~??
choice_data_list: It suits you perfectly.
It looks great on you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right~♡ I am seriously a genius of cuteness♡
Shooting was pretty fun, too♡
choice_data_list: (Wait, didn't she also...)

text_block_list.text:
I could have sworn she said shooting was another thing she'd gotten bored of.
Before I can ponder the mystery, though―

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alllriiight! For the grand finale―that one♪
Let's go, let's go~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! So refreshing♪
Even when it's crazy hot out, we can still do this here~―

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Sketching♪
choice_data_list: ...Didn't you say you were bored of drawing, too―

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Hey... don't tell me you're not gonna draw?
You're not gonna draw~~? Come onnnnn!

I still can't quite figure out what she's aiming for.
Still―it doesn't really matter. As long as she's having fun.
choice_data_list: Alright! I'm gonna draw a masterpiece~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oho, wanna challenge me?
Just so you know, you're looking at a contest champion~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
―Alright, all done♪
Trainer... how's yours coming?
choice_data_list: Nrrgh, almost...!

text_block_list.text:
As expected of Fusaichi Pandora. I'm not even halfway through.
I scramble to move my brush... but finishing this will take some time.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Look at you trying your best♪
choice_data_list: S-Sorry. I'll hurry up.
S-Sorry. I'll hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Take your time, no rush at all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it really is that after all.
choice_data_list: Huh, Pandora?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Nihi.
Hey, I finally found it! My real hob·by♡

Startled by the sudden topic, I stop my brush. Revisiting all the things
she claimed to be bored of―maybe there was a reason behind it after all.
choice_data_list: What did you get hooked on?
What did you get hooked on?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Annnnd that wouuuld beee~...――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Tadaa! Look!!

Fusaichi Pandora holds up the drawing for me to see.
Depicted on the page is—
choice_data_list: Is that... me?
Is that... me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Remember when we played guitar together before? You remember, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course I do.
Yeah, of course I do.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I had sooo much fun back then!
So, I tried playing by myself back at the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —But... you know what? It was totally boring all alone.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then it hit me!
The real reason why I've been having non-stop fun lately!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer! Will you grant me a little selfish wish?♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't make that "I always listen to your wishes anyway" face~~~~! Come oooon~~~~!
choice_data_list: Alright, alright. So... what is it?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I finally found it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Something I truly care about... Something I never, ever want to let go of—
—So...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare let me get bored of you, okay?♡
